watch_list.short_title: Voice chat to learn and rehearse
watch_list.summary: Start a voice chat and ask your Bot to quiz you, recite material back, or pitch your deck so you hear what’s stuck.
Point @bot at a bug thread and tell it to reproduce and fix it inside a named project.

trendy.short_title: Hey Grok wake word on iPhone
trendy.summary: Use Shortcuts + Vocal Shortcuts so saying Hey Grok opens Grok Bot voice chat with no extra apps.
Stop three bots from redoing the same research by wiring a shared knowledge store from GitHub instead of per-chat memory alone.
Run Grok Bot as chief of staff for admin and research, then delegate builds to Codex with a Dot-style EA bot.

trendy.short_title: Claude Code hands jobs to Grok Bot
trendy.summary: Use a template so Claude Code or another agent prepares an assignment and sends it straight to Grok Bot.
Open a voice chat and let your CoS interview you until a rough idea becomes a clear brief.

items.title: This is why your AI locations never match
items.summary: Tip Short: generate the whole set in one 3/4 image so AI locations stay consistent shot-to-shot instead of guessing from a straight-on frame.

items.title: One AI Take, Four New Camera Angles
items.summary: Tip Short on spinning one AI take into four new camera angles (points to ~16:02 in the full short-drama workflow tutorial).

items.title: Stop Using Photos as AI Actor References
items.summary: Tip Short arguing video references beat still photos for AI actors (full tutorial callout at ~03:31).

items.title: The twist that makes people binge short dramas
items.summary: Short-drama tip: start the twist from a feeling everyone recognizes so viewers chase the next episode.

items.title: Stop Rendering Every AI Test in HD
items.summary: Tip Short to draft AI tests at 480p instead of burning time on HD renders for every try (full tutorial at ~07:02).
